**2h**

For this session, I decided to start designing how Starbie would look like and how it would function!

### 2026-10-09 – For this session, I managed to clean up and get more work done on the PCB :)

**2.5h**

For this session, I managed to clean up and get more work done on the PCB :)

### 2026-10-11 – Finished up the PCB and started on firmware!

**3.75h**

Finished up the PCB and started on firmware!

![Screenshot 2026-10-11 at 4.01.32 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/5P3Dphgp8XJhnIuD5gc00fblVm4s8Lon/e302541e2475fff046ebdc3e613baa183807192c583c55ed9349cf73c35eb761.png)
Started this session off by changing the footprint of the XIAO to match to the C3 just in case so it wouldn’t cause any problems in the future. Managed to find a library and downloaded it (it worked yay!) However, I immediately ran into a few problems. Suddenly some parts of my PCB were unrouted..? Even though it looked like the lines were literally on the pad. I ended up taking more than an hour to fix this 😞 I was trying out different ways and in the end it had to do with the lines being F.cu/B.cu so once I changed them around, everything was properly routed! 😌

![Screenshot 2026-10-11 at 5.18.23 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/5P3Dphgp8XJhnIuD5gc00fblVm4s8Lon/6719d4faeac924040a7ea91ae92e02089ce67fd403358faa5c757987c0b26451.png)
Learnt how to do a ground plane! Watched YouTube and got it after a while :) Ended up changing my edge cuts border a lil to align everything w the fill too

![Screenshot 2026-10-11 at 5.47.50 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/5P3Dphgp8XJhnIuD5gc00fblVm4s8Lon/f95a5a415f0063c6e94bc7bda50cbd60c8c544fe5ae0e7769751a6ecf2afb573.png)
After making sure everything on the PCB was ready, I moved onto adding images on the PCB yayyy 😁 I was a little confused at first but all I had to change was to make it a footprint to F.cu silkscreen (which I did not do at first ahem 😬) Had fun designing this part! Added a cute lil star (represents starbie!) and the half life logo as well as ‘starbie 2026’ for record! Had to tweak and try different sizes until I was satisfied. Loved how it turned out :)

![Screenshot 2026-10-11 at 6.52.12 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/5P3Dphgp8XJhnIuD5gc00fblVm4s8Lon/9e8d70c1289a2170192500c21fe1af82092a823e388a09818783fda30e498767.png)
Finally, moving on to the software of Starbie!! Well I’m not too sure how this’ll go since I don’t have any coding experience but I shall figure it out along the way :) Downloaded the Arduino IDE and installed everything required by the guide. Ran into a teeny problem while following it as I didn’t know what they meant by installing the Starbie.ino  but google was there to help, fortunately

### 2026-10-11 – Finishing off Week 1 for Starbie!

**4.5h**

Finishing off Week 1 for Starbie!

![Screenshot 2026-10-11 at 9.07.19 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/5P3Dphgp8XJhnIuD5gc00fblVm4s8Lon/d63c4589a392c46f6452b3b095e63e3cd650f8b568cc0958d231bfad78f72915.png)
Getting into the firmware, I had absolutely no idea what was going on... Tried to read the code and understand the logic as much as possible (haha...) Decided I'd make my sprite first since it was something I could manage!

![Screenshot 2026-10-12 at 2.17.01 AM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/5P3Dphgp8XJhnIuD5gc00fblVm4s8Lon/c86f63baf3ad4edeb1d75529f43cf10e14325b432801293781ebc13afdde0750.png)
Made my sprite! I settled on just eyes and a mouth since the OLED display is going to be quite small. Converted it using the image2cpp and got the byte array. Hooray!

![Screenshot 2026-10-11 at 11.06.21 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/5P3Dphgp8XJhnIuD5gc00fblVm4s8Lon/8e00ea6658da52584833e534f714f4eb6626f6ad958eec6ecbe5d9d4b6b2d20c.png)
After which, I followed the guide on what to add. (I was kinda doing the guide here backwards, don't mind me heh...) Was a tad bit confused but that's alright, because I tried!

![Screenshot 2026-10-12 at 2.16.17 AM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/5P3Dphgp8XJhnIuD5gc00fblVm4s8Lon/64c4cb4b36deeb1d0aef4bbb23f619b9f61d04d1f63c64700e2abb2145baa760.png)
Finally started on collating my BOM and putting it into Half Life (which took a considerable amount of time...) and then put it into a .csv file to add it into my repo! Staying in the Tier 1 fund of $30 was quite difficult but luckily I have a few items on hand already :)

![Screenshot 2026-10-12 at 2.16.04 AM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/5P3Dphgp8XJhnIuD5gc00fblVm4s8Lon/f72e7f9eeb34445f877a454733959a8666e1589500ffe39d2ce33dcc7a3b464f.png)
It was the last stretch! Finalising everything and adding everything into my repo on GitHub! This one took quite a while since I didn't know how to export anything or how to even make a file in GitHub... but google and youtube were my best friends here and I got the hang of making files HAHA
Managed to export the KiCad files, Arduino IDE, and Gerber files (very interesting!) and tidied everything up in the repo. Also updated the README.md (heavily referenced from the guide) :D

This week has definitely been an eventful first week. I've learnt so so many things. Being exposed to hardware for the first time: now I know how to use KiCad (WOAH) and using the Arduino IDE firmware (still getting there though). Plus, it's always nice to see everyone else's amazing and creative ideas!
I'll be updating Starbie along the way since it's far from perfect, but I'm happy with how far I've come YAY
